text.p: Goldman Sachs analyst Laura Conigliaro raised her per-share estimates and target price for Sun Microsystems Inc and maintained the stock on Goldman's U.S. Recommended List, the firm said.

In a research note, the analyst said she has raised her per share estimate for fiscal 1998 to $2.35 from $2.20, based on revenue growth of 23 percent instead of her previous expectation of 16 percent. Conigliaro also raised her target price to $60, roughly 21 times her calendar 1999 estimate.
Sun shares, which had risen to four straight closing highs this week, were unchanged at 45-9/16 in afternoon trade.

The stock was the third most actively-traded issue on the Nasdaq market after Intel Corp and Microsoft Corp, with more than 14.5 million shares changing hands by late afternoon, some three times recent normal daily volume.

Noting Sun's revenue growth hit a 26 percent year over year in the fourth quarter, despite a tough comparison to the year earlier period with few new products, Conigliaro said Sun's underlying growth rate now appears to have accelerated.
"In contrast, fiscal 1998 is awash with new products, giving Sun ample opportunity to capitalize on its current momentum," she wrote in the investment note.
